Nina — thanks for the flag and the attachment.

Quick take:
- If Logiscope will act as a subprocessor receiving customer data under the current MSA, we typically treat this as a subprocessor change notice that requires either: (a) an explicit Order Form amendment to list the subprocessor when the change affects obligations (SLA/location/data residency), or (b) a notice + attestation when the change is operational and covered by the existing DPA controls.

I don't think we need a full Order Form rewrite unless Nebula expects different SLAs or residency guarantees. That said, because Logiscope is in Ireland and your account is EU-centric, Lauren, can you advise whether we require an Order Form clause revision to capture regional processing?

Also, please share Logiscope's DPA/attestation documents (or we can accept your attestation if it covers the subcontractor). Karthik — procurement will want the DocuSign path and any PO prerequisites.

Next steps proposed:
1) Lauren to confirm legal stance on Order Form amendment vs notice.
2) Karthik to confirm procurement steps and whether Nebula's attestation suffices.
3) Nina to provide Logiscope attestation or DPA (we've got ACME_DPA_v2.pdf on file for comparison).

Kimberly / Karthik — reviewed the change notice. Short answer: notice + attestation should be sufficient provided all three checks pass:

1) Scope parity — the subcontractor will process the same categories of data and uses only the same processing activities.
2) Controls parity — Logiscope provides an attestation that they meet the DPA controls we require (encryption at rest/in transit, access controls, incident reporting).
3) No SLA/regulatory delta — there are no new residency or retention commitments beyond what's in the existing Order Form.

If any of those fail, we should trigger an Order Form amendment to explicitly enumerate the subprocessor and any residency/SLA changes.

Action items I recommend we take now:
- Karthik: ask Nebula for Logiscope's SOC- or ISO-equivalent attestation and the executed subcontract (or attestation).
- Kimberly: we'll produce a short approval memo and update the subprocessor register. I'll prepare language that we can attach to the DPA as an annex (if Nebula prefers a signed amendment).

I'll schedule a 30-min triage call if we don't get the attestation by EOD Wed.
